# Net Power Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Provides Business Update


November 12, 2026 4:15pm EST


## Related Documents


[Earnings Webcast Audio](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=WQRHfQgN)


[Presentation PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_017be9ac7e037f421b9de7acb060ee65/netpower/db/3880/36948/presentation/Q3_2026_Earnings_Presentation_FINAL.pdf)


[10-Q HTML](https://ir.netpower.com/financial-information/sec-filings/content/0001845437-26-000040/npwr-20260930.htm)[XBRL Zip](https://ir.netpower.com/financial-information/sec-filings/content/0001845437-26-000040/0001845437-26-000040-xbrl.zip)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Net Power Inc. (NYSE: NPWR) (“Net Power” or the “Company”) today announced its financial and operational results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“This past quarter, we recalibrated our strategy to what data center customers need today and over the next decade: fast, reliable, and scalable power. Our power solution is being designed to deliver exactly that, and, just as important, our focus on co-located configurations is intended to let us serve that demand without impacting the electric grid or the customers who rely on it,” said Danny Rice, Chief Executive Officer of Net Power. “We are advancing the powered land opportunities in front of us with an eye toward delivering reliable power as quickly as possible, and we will continue to allocate our balance sheet capital prudently as we work toward executing a definitive energy services agreement and project financing for our first project.”


**Key Business Updates:**


- **Additional development site:** The Company is developing its initial natural gas power generation project (the “Initial Project”) to supply islanded power to a co-located data center for a prospective customer, a leading developer of frontier artificial intelligence models, at a site in Texas that is separate from the Project Permian site. The Company intends to deploy its ten Wärtsilä reciprocating engine generating units at this location. The Company continues to develop its Project Permian site in West Texas (“Project Permian”) as its second project, on a longer timeline.
- **Building-by-building design:** Net Power is developing a custom, data center power solution with a standardized, building-by-building design. The power stack for the building at the Initial Project is being designed as a single solution, composed of bundled reciprocating engines and batteries for energy storage with capacity redundancy to meet stringent deliverability requirements.
- **Equipment purchases:** During the third quarter, **** Net Power continued to procure long-lead power generation equipment for the Initial Project. As previously announced, the Company has entered into a cost reimbursement agreement with the prospective data center customer in August 2026. If no energy services agreement has been executed by February 14, 2027, or if certain other events occur, the customer must reimburse the Company’s nonrefundable costs of approved expense items, up to approximately $180.0 million and subject to conditions, unless the Company elects to keep the related equipment. The Company continues to advance negotiations toward a definitive energy services agreement with the prospective customer.
- **Financial position:** The Company ended the quarter with approximately $183 million in cash, cash equivalents, and investments and no debt. The Company’s liquidity forecast assumes that it does not issue full notice to proceed under its EPC agreement or make additional significant equipment or construction commitments without committed financing or other capital. On that basis, the Company believes its existing cash and available-for-sale securities will be sufficient to meet its obligations for at least the next 12 months. Completing the Initial Project will require project-level financing and additional capital, none of which has been committed.


**Conference Call**


Net Power will host a conference call to share third quarter 2026 results and related matters beginning at 8:30 AM ET on Friday, November 13, 2026. To access the live audio webcast of the conference call, please visit Net Power’s investor relations website at[ir.netpower.com](https://ir.netpower.com/) . To participate by phone, dial 877-407-8014 (domestic) or +1 201-689-8053 (international). A presentation accompanying the call will be available on the investor relations website.


An archived webcast will be available following the call.


**About Net Power**


Net Power Inc. (NYSE: NPWR) (“Net Power” or the “Company”) is an energy technology and project development company. The Company’s near-term development activities are focused on delivering natural gas power generation to meet growing demand for reliable power.
